author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **Wormhole v3.4.1** — the ultimate cross-server relay!

Get started: `[p]wh create <network-name>` then `[p]wh open <network-name>` in channels you want to link.

New in v3.4.1: Relay engine hardening — command filter uses Red's internal command resolution (no more dropped messages), top-level error handling, safer background loops.

Full help: `[p]wh help` or `/wh help`
name: Wormhole
short: The ultimate cross-server relay — hybrid commands, context menus, ToS, reports, mentions policy, 85+ commands.
description: Wormhole v3.4.0 connects Discord channels across multiple servers into named networks. All commands work as both slash commands and prefix commands (hybrid). Features: real-time message relay (webhooks/embeds/compact), edit/delete/reaction/reply/sticker/pin/typing sync, bidirectional DM relay, auto-moderation engine, granular mention policy (per-network + per-server + per-user), Terms of Service acceptance gate with legal template, user report system with mod actions, context menu actions (report/bookmark/delete/profile), cross-network starboard, karma system, keyword highlights, invite codes with vanity URLs, staff announcements, portal embeds, user profiles, backup/restore, blackout scheduling, anonymous mode, network-wide polls, AFK system, auto-responses, ephemeral messages, analytics dashboard, health monitoring, message bookmarks, user colours, quiet hours, network bridging, and much more.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, guild IDs, and channel IDs for relay functionality. Per-user data includes message counts, karma scores, keyword highlights, DM relay subscriptions, bookmarks, AFK status, ignore lists, colour preferences, quiet hour settings, analytics counters, ToS acceptance timestamps, and report records.
